integrity: The conclusion rests on a complete written proof. A finite reproducibility checker verifies logical finite configurations and exact small expectations, not asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic threshold is for ordinary modal formulas of depth at most one, with fixed edge probability and independent uniform vertex colors, strictly outside the critical ratio. Neither the critical window nor unrestricted-depth non-generation below threshold is established. Independently corroborated publication priority is not claimed.
title: A sharp one-step modal separation threshold in dense random frames
